hooks.name: simulator-task-check
hooks.description: After each spec task: full suite incl. property tests, then the demo scenario

action.prompt: A spec task just finished. Run `conda run -n hackachusetts python -m pytest -q` (includes the slow Hypothesis property tests). If anything fails, fix the code, unless the test contradicts .kiro/specs/simulator/requirements.md, in which case stop and explain the conflict. Then run `conda run -n hackachusetts python -m sim.run_batch --scene scenes/mock/flat_stacked_000.json --no-video` and confirm grab_only still reports exactly one double grab. Report the results in two lines.
